headline: Saint Leo end Florida Southern's perfect start
dek: Florida Southern had won all four of their matches before they went to Saint Leo and lost. UAH, Southwest Baptist and Texas A&M International all won the same evening, and each of them is still unbeaten.
displaced_by: results night: Florida Southern's unbeaten start over at Saint Leo
